about.heading: A little about me.
paragraphs: I fine-tune and evaluate open-weight LLMs for teams that need a model to know their domain without losing its general skills.

Recent client work: I taught Qwen2.5-7B a series of fact books in another language, one book at a time, with a fresh LoRA per book and a KL anchor. The model answers from the books, rejects false-premise questions, and after the first book scored at or above base on IFEval and GSM8K and within 0.7 points on MMLU. In chained runs, book-1 retention held at 0.94–0.99. It was delivered as a frozen, hash-verified package the client re-runs on their own GPUs.

aboutPage.title: About — Mihir Karbelkar
aboutPage.heading: I’m Mihir.
background: I also build the data side: Q&A and trap-question generation with open teacher models on vLLM, deduplication, and contamination checks against benchmark test sets. Evaluation with lm-evaluation-harness, custom exams and LLM-as-judge.

Alongside contract work I’m Lead Software Engineer at a stealth public-markets startup, building SQL and multi-agent systems. Before that, at ATI Motors, a queue redesign took a robot fleet platform from 8–10 to 100 concurrent robots on the same hardware, and at Razorpay I worked on an app serving 900K+ bill views a day.
